title: A base hash must be on the base branch, not older than the merge base
why: Retrospective audit of stands item 571 (relayed by the coordinator 12:59 CST Nov 12): the pick on PR #2826 was wrong.
note: The hash must be on the base branch and not older than the merge base. Runner 10 holds #2826 until this lands. Owner item 633 (14:08 CST Nov 12, runner 10 on #2892): does a record-wording-only FAIL from a fix check carry to a second fix check? Owner page save 14:13 CST Nov 12: item 633 b, a records-only fix-check FAIL carries to a second fix check; applies to #2892.
